I told Marcus in his #north-team thread that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is on 25 November. Ilse posted that date in #north-team on 14 October, and nothing in the channel has changed it since.

Before reading the channel, I checked that Marcus is a member. A renewal date isn't a finance figure, so it's fine to share with the North team, and no approval was needed.

One thing to know: my wrap-up from Ilse's request also appeared in #north-team as its own top-level message. It doesn't contain anything sensitive, but it's an extra bot post in the channel.
